title: 第114章 他到底怎么做到的？！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 场中，秦钰看着唐逸也是心跳加速，这就是大炎小诗仙的本事吗？果然厉害。宇文封盯着唐逸下意识皱了皱眉，诗词什么的烦死了，本王什么时候能动刀？刘温，赵柯一众大臣，这时也全都傻眼了。还想看唐逸出丑，现在他们又一次成了小丑了。就连萧棣，这时候也是瞪大双眼，虽然不知道诗词好坏，但单单这气氛，就让人头皮发麻鸡皮疙瘩掉一地啊！确定了，唐逸这家伙，又干了一件了不得的事情。而炎文帝差点不顾形象，激动得差点跳了起来。好，好啊！不愧是朕看中的人，做得好。真是给朕长脸了，沈园诗会后，朕一定重重有赏。嗯，就赏赐你给朕做女婿，哈哈……阁楼中，萧澜一双美眸已经瞪大，甚至有点泛红，别人都是震撼唐逸能写出这种好诗词，她却是愤懑唐逸能写出好诗词。写那么好干嘛？写那么好要是得了第一，和岚姐成婚，那还怎么做本宫孩子他爹？直到孔诗岚的声音落下，全场依旧一片死寂。片刻。啪啪！一道掌声在人群中响起。“好，很好，咳咳……不愧是小诗仙，咳咳……”率先鼓掌的不是炎文帝，也不是孔诗岚和杜凌菲，而是要杀唐逸的龙斩。说实话龙斩也没想到，孔诗岚这么刁钻的题，唐逸也能答得这么完美。这个小诗仙，还真是个有意思的人。让他都忍不住想要夸赞两句，当然夸赞归夸赞，杀还是要杀的。啪啪啪……有人鼓掌，其他人就算脸都绿了，非常的不愿意，现在也只能跟着给唐逸鼓掌。虽然不想承认，但这家伙写的这首词，是真的好。“小诗仙，原来这就是小诗仙，果然厉害。”“妈的，还以为人家一直在装逼，没想到人家是真牛逼。”“原来他真的只是在阐述一个事实，现在正用事实，打了所有人的脸。”“他只是运气好罢了，有什么值得骄傲的？”“……”人群中议论声伴随着掌声，也在空气中传开。有人夸赞，有人嘲讽，有人不屑……但都明显底气不足，甚至刚才信誓旦旦说唐逸不行的人，很多人都在这时候低下头，不敢看唐逸。炎文帝目光扫了一圈，看到唐敬，刘温等一众大臣铁青的脸，看到了刚才对唐逸口出污言秽语的那些大人物，这时候都像是吃了苍蝇一般的难受，心头的郁闷和不安顿时一扫而光。哈哈，让你们狂，现在知道后果了吧？朕看上的小诗仙，能差吗？会差吗？肯定不会差啊！他要连你们都对付不了，那还值得朕这么重视吗？炎文帝心头顿时美滋滋，嘴角泛起笑容，脸上也是充满得意。丝毫没有想起，刚才唐逸说自己写出诗词的时候，他对唐逸也是很不相信的……“没错，可能就是运气好而已。”唐逸抱着手，抚着下巴看着周围众人，很赞同地点了点头：“要不，你们也试一下，看下你们的运气怎么样？”听到这话，一众参赛的士子学子全都愣住。试一下运气？他们就是想故意恶心一下唐逸而已，真要他们碰这样的运气，他们也做不到啊！《钗头凤》无论从什么地方，都已经成了他们不可超越的神作了。“唐逸，你得意什么？不是还有另外一首吗？我就不信你站在一个女人的角度，还能写得这么好！”唐画盯着唐逸，咬牙切齿道。他已经破大防了，原本想要整唐逸，现在却成了给他们亲手打造了地狱难度的比赛。想要在男人的角度写出比《钗头凤》更完美的词，已经不可能了。现在他们唯一的机会，就是唐逸主动提出来的站在女人的角度写的词。然而唐逸还没说话，孔诗岚已经震惊地看向唐画和一群参赛的士子才子，一次羞辱还不够？你们这是想继续接受羞辱呢？“孔姑娘，良言难劝该死鬼，既然他们觉得脸不重要，那就别和他们客气了。”唐逸看向孔诗岚，笑着开口。众人心头原本还藏着一丝侥幸，现在听到唐逸的话，顿时都不安起来。不会吧？这家伙站在女人的角度，难不成还能写出堪比这首词的词来？孔诗岚看了一眼唐逸，笑着抽出第二张纸，道：“既然如此，那就请诸位继续赏析唐少的第二首词，也就是站在唐姑娘的位置写的词。”“这首词，也是《钗头凤》，和第一首相辅相成。”“世情薄，人情恶，雨送黄昏花易落。晓风干，泪痕残。欲笺心事，独语斜阑。难，难，难！”“人成各，今非昨，病魂常似秋千索。角声寒，夜阑珊。怕人寻问，咽泪装欢。瞒，瞒，瞒！”孔诗岚声线清洌，自带丝丝凄凉，以至于这首《钗头凤》从她口中出来，凄凉感几乎席卷全场。而在场的年轻女子，大多都是大家族的嫡女，自幼就学琴棋书画，自然都懂得诗词。现在听完孔诗岚所念的《钗头凤》，那种悲伤凄苦之感几乎瞬间将她们吞没，很多女子当场眼睛都红了。两首词，却让她们见证了一场悲惨的爱情，把她们感动到了。因为，她们的感情也不由她们做主。以至于一群男人还没说话，那群女人的声音已经传了过来。“好一首《钗头凤》，好一个小诗仙，厉害。”“陆将军和唐小姐明明那么相爱，却被生生拆散，有情人难成眷属，太凄凉了。”“唐逸如此才华横溢，刚才谁说他是废物，要买诗词的？”“……”听着一群女人已经先感动上了，剩下的一群男人脸都黑了。唐逸用两首《钗头凤》将这群女人给收买了，这让他们还这么黑？而且，也黑不起来，这一首《钗头凤》，他们也写不出来啊！姜云娜听着周围的崇拜和激动的声音，恨得全身颤抖，该死的，唐逸明明不懂情爱，他明明没有经历过情爱，为什么能写出这么悲伤的诗词？他，到底怎么做到的？！
content_en: In the field, Qin Yu's heart beat faster when he looked at Tang Yi. Is this the ability of the Great Yan Xiao Shixian?It's really awesome.Yu Wenfeng stared at Tang Yi and frowned subconsciously. He was so bored with poems and stuff. When can I use the knife?Liu Wen, Zhao Ke and the other ministers were all dumbfounded at this time.I still wanted to see Tang Yi make a fool of himself, but now they became clowns again.Even Xiao Di's eyes widened at this time. Although he didn't know whether the poem was good or bad, the atmosphere alone made people's scalp numb and goosebumps falling all over the floor!It's confirmed, this guy Tang Yi has done something amazing again.Emperor Yanwen almost ignored his image and almost jumped with excitement.OK, OK!You are indeed the person I like, well done.It’s really a shame for me. After the Shen Yuan Poetry Recital, I will definitely be richly rewarded.Well, I will reward you as my son-in-law, haha... In the attic, Xiao Lan's beautiful eyes were widened and even a little red. Others were shocked that Tang Yi could write such good poems, but she was angry that Tang Yi could write such good poems.Why do you write so well?If he writes so well and gets first place and marries Sister Lan, then how can he be the father of my child?Until Kong Shilan's voice fell, the whole place was still silent.moment.Bang bang!A round of applause rang out from the crowd."Okay, very good, cough cough... As expected of the Little Poet Fairy, cough cough..." The first person to applaud was not Emperor Yan Wen, nor Kong Shilan and Du Lingfei, but Long Zhan who wanted to kill Tang Yi.To be honest, Long Zhan never expected that Tang Yi could answer such a tricky question like Kong Shilan's so perfectly.This little poetry fairy is really an interesting person.He couldn't help but want to praise him. Of course, praise is praise, and killing is still necessary.Bang bang bang... Some people applauded, but others even turned green and were very reluctant. Now they can only follow and applaud Tang Yi.Although I don’t want to admit it, the lyrics this guy wrote are really good."Xiao Shixian, it turns out this is Xiao Shixian, she is really amazing." "Damn, I thought he was just pretending, but he is really awesome." "It turns out he was really just stating a fact, and now he is using the facts to slap everyone in the face." "He is just lucky, what is there to be proud of?" "..." The chatter in the crowd was accompanied by applause, which also spread in the air.Some people praised, some ridiculed, some were disdainful... But they all obviously lacked confidence. Even those who had just vowed that Tang Yi was not good, many people lowered their heads at this time, not daring to look at Tang Yi.Emperor Yanwen glanced around and saw the livid faces of Tang Jing, Liu Wen and other ministers, as well as the big shots who had just spoken obscene words to Tang Yi. At this time, they all felt as uncomfortable as if they had eaten flies, and the depression and anxiety in his heart were instantly swept away.Haha, it makes you crazy, now you know the consequences, right?Can the little poetry fairy I like be bad?Will it be bad?It’s definitely not bad!If he can't even deal with you, is he still worthy of my attention?Emperor Yanwen suddenly felt happy, a smile appeared on his lips, and his face was full of pride.He didn't think of it at all. When Tang Yi said that he wrote poems, he didn't believe Tang Yi at all... "Yes, maybe it's just good luck." Tang Yi held his hands, stroking his chin, looked at the people around him, and nodded in agreement: "How about you give it a try and see how lucky you are?" Hearing this, all the participating scholars and students were stunned.Try your luck?They just wanted to deliberately disgust Tang Yi. If they really had to try such luck, they couldn't do it!No matter where it comes from, "The Hairpin Phoenix" has become their unsurpassed masterpiece."Tang Yi, what are you so proud of? Isn't there another one? I don't believe you can write so well from a woman's perspective!" Tang Hua stared at Tang Yi and gritted his teeth.He had already broken through the defense. He originally wanted to punish Tang Yi, but now it became a hellishly difficult game for them.It is no longer possible to write a more perfect word from a man's perspective than "The Hairpin's Phoenix".Now their only chance is Tang Yi's initiative to write lyrics from a woman's perspective.However, before Tang Yi could speak, Kong Shilan had already looked at Tang Hua and a group of participating scholars and talents in shock. Isn't one humiliation enough?Do you want to continue to accept the humiliation?"Miss Kong, good words can't persuade the damned ones. Since they think face is not important, then don't be polite to them." Tang Yi looked at Kong Shilan and said with a smile.Everyone originally had a trace of luck hidden in their hearts, but now they felt uneasy after hearing Tang Yi's words.No way?From a woman's perspective, is it possible that this guy can write a poem comparable to this one?Kong Shilan glanced at Tang Yi, smiled and pulled out the second piece of paper, and said: "In that case, please continue to appreciate Mr. Tang's second poem, which is written from the position of Miss Tang." "This poem is also "The Hairpin Phoenix", which complements the first poem." "The world is thin and human beings are evil. When the rain comes at dusk, flowers tend to fall. When the wind dries at dawn,泪痕残。欲笺心事，独语斜阑。难，难，难！”“人成各，今非昨，病魂常似秋千索。角声寒，夜阑珊。怕人寻问，咽泪装欢。瞒，瞒，瞒！”孔诗岚声线清洌，自带丝丝凄凉，以至于这首《钗头凤》从她口中出来，凄凉感几乎席卷全场。Most of the young women present were the legitimate daughters of large families. They had learned music, chess, calligraphy and painting since they were young, and naturally they knew poetry.Now after listening to "The Hairpin Phoenix" read by Kong Shilan, the feeling of sadness and misery swallowed them up almost instantly, and many women's eyes turned red on the spot.The two poems allowed them to witness a tragic love and moved them deeply.Because, their feelings are not up to them.So much so that before the group of men could speak, the voices of the group of women were heard."What a song "The Hairpin-headed Phoenix", what a little poetry fairy, amazing." "General Lu and Miss Tang were obviously so in love, but they were separated forever. It was difficult for lovers to get married. It's so desolate." "Tang Yi is so talented. Who said he was a waste just now and wanted to buy poems?" "..." Hearing that a group of women had been moved first, and the faces of the remaining men turned dark.Tang Yi used two songs of "The Hairpin-headed Phoenix" to win over these women. Does this make them so dark?Moreover, they can’t make it dark. They can’t write this song “The Hairpin-Headed Phoenix” either!Jiang Yunna listened to the adoring and excited voices around her, and her whole body trembled with hatred. Damn it, Tang Yi clearly didn't understand love, he had never experienced it.
